responsibility: Provides the shared LLVM interop layer for `rustc_codegen_llvm`: `ffi.rs` defines the raw ABI bindings, enums, structs, and extern calls to LLVM and rustc’s LLVM wrapper; `mod.rs` builds the higher-level support facade on top of those bindings with ergonomic wrappers and re-exports for common backend operations; `diagnostic.rs` translates raw LLVM diagnostic records into structured Rust diagnostics; and `archive_ro.rs` supplies safe read-only access to LLVM archive handling for `.a` files. Together these files centralize the backend’s low-level LLVM access, resource ownership, and decoding of LLVM-produced data into Rust-facing forms used by code generation and tooling support.
